description: This file defines a request class 'DeleteCatalogItemRequest' used for deleting catalog items in the eShopOnWeb Public API. It inherits from 'BaseRequest' and encapsulates the catalog item ID to be deleted.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemRequest
classes.description: A request model class (immutable after initialization) for deleting a catalog item identified by CatalogItemId.

methods.name: DeleteCatalogItemRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with the provided catalog item ID.
